notes: This minor release requires Bifrost 0.15.0 or later. Five existing policies use the resolved-value RQL operator and now declare the resolved-value capability that Bifrost 0.15.0 is the first release to advertise: bifrost.csharp-codeql-quality.call-to-obsolete-method, .console-output and .use-of-file-upload (bifrost.csharp-codeql-quality 0.4.0) and bifrost.security.csharp.xmldocument-url-resolver and bifrost.security.python.insecure-protocol (bifrost.security 2.0.0). A consumer engine older than 0.15.0 rejects the bundle at admission. use-of-file-upload resolves no call targets, so it no longer requires exact-call-target. Policy sources, IDs and findings are unchanged. It also adds six CodeQL C# ports to bifrost.csharp-codeql-quality 0.4.0 that need C# facts Bifrost 0.15.0 is the first release to provide: incomplete-parity-check, class-name-comparison, lock-this, empty-lock-statement, self-assignment (locals and parameters only) and calls-unmanaged-code, and corrects recursive-equals-call to select calls made from Equals bodies (bifrost-packs#149). Since rules 0.7.0 the release also adds the C# password-in-configuration and empty-password-in-configuration policies to bifrost.csharp-codeql-quality and the C# XmlDocument XmlUrlResolver and SignedXml embedded-key trust policies to bifrost.security, corrects bifrost.csharp-codeql-quality.call-to-gc and .useless-if-statement against CodeQL's tests, and changes the exact native dependency from bifrost.public.packs 0.7.0 to 0.8.0, which ships compiled the public packs Bifrost previously supplied only through its embedded built-in registry. Publish packs/v0.8.0 first. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
